description:
Lawful development: Proposed use.

This project proposes the design, construction, and outfitting of a dedicated, permanent Early Years Provision on the school grounds. This new facility will accommodate the Two-Year-Old Provision, ensuring the continued delivery of essential early education as the main school roll expands to a full two-form entry (2FE) capacity by September 2027. In September 2026, all teaching spaces will be in full use, and the current 2-year-old provision is at risk of closing if an additional space cannot be created.

Construction Works Required
The proposed construction will utilize a currently underutilized area of the school grounds (e.g., a non-essential paved area or surplus land), specifically chosen for its potential to provide appropriate, high-quality outdoor learning space. The project will involve:

1.	Groundworks and Site Preparation: Laying foundations, connecting utilities (water, electricity, data, drainage).

2.	Modular or Traditional Build: Construction of a single, self-contained building feature:
o	One classroom for 2-Year-Olds provision.
o	Dedicated children’s accessible toilet facilities and changing areas.
o	A small kitchen/snack preparation area.
o	Secure storage for learning resources and cleaning supplies.

3. External Works and Outdoor Environment:
o	Installation of secure perimeter fencing and gating for safeguarding.
o	Creation of a safe, all-weather outdoor learning environment (OLE) with appropriate safety surfacing.
o	Integration of natural play elements, sand/water areas, and dedicated quiet zones.
